character: the ember seeress (D7, Matt R-C9-80; Costume A, base SO-1 b, Matt G1-S)
height_note: authored at 1.70 m, 0.92x the barbarian's 1.85 m. If the scene normalises each character to a fixed pixel height she will read as tall as him -- apply the BARBARIAN's world factor to her too so the difference survives.

skeleton.note: 26 joints, weapon_r/weapon_l APPENDED last (indices 24, 25) by 52_weapon_bones, identical in the body and every piece (gear.gd compares the lists in order). Indices match legolas's Godot 4.6.3 probe of the convention.

clip_selection.staff: the staff is on weapon_r; the grip calibration (--roll) and off-hand IK are a later step

locomotion_in_place.rule: locomotion ships IN PLACE. Drive her at the FOOT-LOCK speed: the speed that holds the planted foot still.

run.caution: only 10 planted intervals (a run's contacts are brief): the widest estimate here

locomotion_in_place.method: Meshy's walk and run are in place AT SOURCE (net root travel 0.000 / 0.004 m), so travel/duration gives ~0. The planted foot slides back at exactly her ground speed; the median of that, over intervals with the foot down at both ends, is the speed.

cast_fireball.why: fastest release of the three throws (5.35 m/s against 4.43 and 3.30), and the leading hand is her LEFT -- the free hand, since the staff is in her right. 126 and 136 throw with the right, which would swing the staff.
cast_fireball.definition: the instant of the leading hand's peak FORWARD speed -- a throw is defined by its release speed

cast_meteor.why: a raise to 0.355 m above the head then a DROP at 8.48 m/s, nearly three times either alternative (2.86, 3.28). The hand is her RIGHT -- the staff hand -- so she lifts the staff to the sky and drives it down: the call-down, literally.
cast_meteor.definition: the instant of peak DOWNWARD speed after the hand's highest point -- a raise alone is a salute, a drop alone a slap

root_motion.note: hit and death carried ~1 m of knockback; shipped IN PLACE with the travel here, so the scene can re-apply it if the design wants the capsule to move. The casts do not drift.

clip_hygiene.joint_scale: idle AND walk ('Walking Woman') both arrived with Meshy's constant Hips scale 1.176471 -- the barbarian's defect, in two clips. The ARRIVAL LINT RECORDED BOTH AS FAIL; stripped and re-grounded from the feet (min rule).

circlet.fit: the head's outline at brow height, 64 directions, +4 mm -- a single radius floated it as a halo
circlet.why: Tripo isolation did not separate a ~1 cm band from the scalp: 24,726 verts with the whole face attached, or 1,455 verts in 3 fragments. At 100.6 px/m it is ~1 px in play.

isolation_predicates.note: recorded here because D2's were passed on the command line and lost

sheet_A.why: at-zero/peak 0.960 vs 0.943; face_S registers exactly (1.000 vs 0.900)

sheet_B.why: at-zero/peak 0.945 vs 0.913; face_S 0.916 vs 0.786, face_SE 0.828 vs 0.795; and b KEPT an invented braid over the front head close-up after its retry (receipt)

timing_D5.definition: WALL = end - start, vendor queues included. VENDOR = the generator's own measured poll time (Tripo, Meshy, Astra), recorded by the call that waited. AGENT = wall - vendor.
timing_D5.disk_block: 228 s of pure idle is the only interval booked to it; the pause itself ran ~17 min (22:24-22:41) and heavy steps WAITED throughout, so its true elapsed cost is larger
timing_D5.step_table: work/timing.jsonl -- note S5/S7/S8 overlap; do not sum the per-step walls
not_in_d7: staff grip calibration (weapon_r --roll) and off-hand IK -- deferred by the dispatch
grip morphs (grip_R) to close her hand on the staff -- in the charter's tooling list, NOT done
